import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import time
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

print(f"Current time: {time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}")

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
try:
    train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/en_train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/en_test_2.csv")
    sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/en_sample_submission_2.csv")
except FileNotFoundError as e:
    print(f"Data file not found: {e}")
    train_df = pd.read_csv("input/en_train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("input/en_test_2.csv")
    sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/en_sample_submission_2.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_submission.shape}")

# Create ID mapping for test using sentence_id and token_id columns
test_ids = [f"{row['sentence_id']}_{row['token_id']}" for _, row in test_df.iterrows()]
print(f"Number of test IDs: {len(test_ids)}")

# CRITICAL FIX: Split MUST happen BEFORE building any mapping to prevent contamination
print("Performing train/val split...")
train_pairs_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "before": train_df["before"].dropna().astype(str),
        "after": train_df["after"].dropna().astype(str),
        "class": train_df["class"].dropna(),
    }
)
train_pairs_df = train_pairs_df.dropna()

train_split, val_split = train_test_split(
    train_pairs_df, test_size=0.1, random_state=42
)

print(f"Training split size: {len(train_split):,}")
print(f"Validation split size: {len(val_split):,}")


def build_class_mapping(df, class_col="class", key="before", value="after"):
    """
    Builds class-aware token mappings using majority voting.
    Groups by (token, class) to get more specific mappings than global mapping alone.
    """
    mappings = {}
    for cls in df[class_col].unique():
        class_df = df[df[class_col] == cls]
        mode_map = class_df.groupby(key)[value].agg(
            lambda x: x.value_counts().index[0] if len(x) > 0 else x.iloc[0]
        )
        mappings[cls] = mode_map.to_dict()
    return mappings


def predict_class_from_distribution(before_token, class_distribution):
    """Predict class from training data distribution."""
    if before_token in class_distribution:
        return class_distribution[before_token]
    return "PLAIN"


def get_token_prediction(
    before_token, class_mappings, predicted_class, class_distribution
):
    """Get token prediction using class-aware mapping with fallbacks."""
    if before_token is None or pd.isna(before_token):
        return before_token

    before_str = str(before_token)

    if predicted_class in class_mappings:
        if before_str in class_mappings[predicted_class]:
            return class_mappings[predicted_class][before_str]
        # Try general fallback to PLAIN class if available
        if "PLAIN" in class_mappings and before_str in class_mappings["PLAIN"]:
            return class_mappings["PLAIN"][before_str]

    # Final fallback to UNKNOWN class
    if "UNKNOWN" in class_mappings and before_str in class_mappings["UNKNOWN"]:
        return class_mappings["UNKNOWN"][before_str]

    return before_str


# Build class distribution from full training data for test inference
print("Building class distribution from full training data...")
class_distribution = (
    train_pairs_df.groupby("before")["class"]
    .agg(lambda x: x.mode().iloc[0] if len(x) > 0 else "UNKNOWN")
    .to_dict()
)
print(f"Total unique tokens: {len(class_distribution)}")

# Class-aware mapping building from train_split only for contamination-free validation
print("Building class-aware token mappings from train_split only...")
class_mappings_val = build_class_mapping(train_split)
num_train_classes_val = len(class_mappings_val)
total_class_mappings_val = sum(len(v) for v in class_mappings_val.values())
print(f"Train split classes found: {num_train_classes_val}")
print(f"Total unique (token, class) entries: {total_class_mappings_val}")

# Hold-out validation using contamination-free class-aware mapping
print("Validating with class-aware, contamination-free mapping...")
val_actual = list(val_split["after"])
val_pred = []
for before_token, class_token in zip(val_split["before"], val_split["class"]):
    pred = get_token_prediction(before_token, class_mappings_val, class_token, {})
    val_pred.append(pred)

val_accuracy = accuracy_score(val_actual, val_pred)
print(
    f"Validation accuracy (hold-out, contamination-free, class-aware): {val_accuracy:.4f}"
)

# Build final predictions on test set using FULL training data
print("Generating final predictions on test set using full training data...")
full_class_mappings = build_class_mapping(train_pairs_df)
num_train_classes_full = len(full_class_mappings)
total_class_mappings_full = sum(len(v) for v in full_class_mappings.values())
print(f"Full training classes found: {num_train_classes_full}")
print(f"Total unique (token, class) entries: {total_class_mappings_full}")

# Generate predictions for test set with class inference
final_predictions = []
for idx, row in test_df.iterrows():
    before = str(row["before"]) if pd.notna(row["before"]) else ""

    # Infer class from training distribution
    pred_class = predict_class_from_distribution(before, class_distribution)
    after = get_token_prediction(
        before, full_class_mappings, pred_class, class_distribution
    )

    pred_id = f"{row['sentence_id']}_{row['token_id']}"
    final_predictions.append({"id": pred_id, "after": after})

# Save predictions to submission file - PRESERVED EXACTLY
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

id_list = [f"{row['sentence_id']}_{row['token_id']}" for _, row in test_df.iterrows()]
pred_list = [final_predictions[i]["after"] for i in range(len(test_df))]

submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": id_list, "after": pred_list})
submission_df = submission_df.sort_values(by=["id"]).reset_index(drop=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(
    f"Validation accuracy (contamination-free hold-out, class-aware): {val_accuracy:.4f}"
)

print(f"\nCompleted at {time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}")
